Proposed by Auditchain Labs; not required by the proposed rule. The Rule 103 information an issuer relying on the startup exemption must make publicly accessible at the website named in its Form NOR, and any amendment made within 30 days after a calendar year-end because of material changes. Functional unit of covered investment contract and Rule 101(e) equivalents [abstract]

Proposed by Auditchain Labs; not required by the proposed rule. Auditchain Labs recommends (Requests for Comment 6, 7 and 31) that an issuer may define the unit of a covered investment contract as a functional unit: the subject crypto asset together with the software or other technical primitives the crypto asset invokes and that an institution needs to stand up and operate the network (for Pacioli.ai, a Pacioli Validating Node of 50,000 AUDT with its node software license). The elements below carry the crypto-asset content of each unit and the measures Rule 101(e) as proposed would report, so the Commission can read the offering either way and the per-crypto-asset arithmetic can be checked. The recommendation is intended to make the exemption easier to use for building real utility than for a token sale with nothing behind it.
